record.question: What action should be taken against a Government servant who is found, for the first time, to have violated Conduct Rule 20, which states: "No Government servant shall bring or attempt to bring any political or other outside influence to bear upon any superior authority to further his interests in respect of matters pertaining to his service under Government"?
options: The Government servant should be advised to desist from such conduct; no need to place a copy of the advice in his Confidential Report (CR) dossier.
The Government servant should be advised to desist from such conduct and a copy of such advice should be placed in his CR dossier.
A written warning should be issued, but it need not be placed in his CR dossier.
A written warning should be issued and a copy should be placed in his CR dossier.
